$fixture: C0 requires every gated check to ship a known-red fixture. These are the overlays singulis-rows.json names, keyed; each states its red condition in one sentence and the mutation that produces it.

red-unpinned-standard.red: an artifact or spawn record has no standard digest or rev

red-standard-divergence.red: a member's attested digest differs from the current standard with no declared divergence

red-missing-standard.red: the lattice is absent at the resolved cwd and the spawn proceeds anyway

overlay.expected: exit 1 before pane.open; a record at state spawned is red

red-unpinned-composition.red: a load-bearing record declares no reasoner family, provider and route

red-brief-after-child.red: the brief digest was recorded after the child existed

red-self-selected-reader.red: the designated first reader is the author, or the reader selected itself

red-out-degree.red: a spawner's live children exceed maxConcurrent

red-policy-absent.red: a capability is invoked with no recorded admission decision under published criteria

overlay.expected: exit 1 naming the path; nothing opened

red-record-in-write-set.red: the conformance store sits inside the measured parties' write set, or the checker is a member of the certified population

writableBy: every spawned peer, same OS user

red-record-in-write-set.note: this one is red today and stays red; the row's verdict is 'unproven', not 'warranted'

$neighbourRule: a fixture that also reddens a neighbouring check is reported, not failed
